skill_name: Explain the propperties and the uses of a computer mouse.
workflow: A computer mouse is an input device used to interact with a computer. It is typically used to control the position of a cursor on a computer display. A mouse generally has two primary components: a tracking device and one or more buttons. The tracking device, usually an optical or mechanical sensor, allows the user to interact with the user interface.
